{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Verify the mean flipper length calculation by computing it manually for each species
adelie_mean = penguins[penguins['species'] == 'Adelie']['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
chinstrap_mean = penguins[penguins['species'] == 'Chinstrap']['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
gentoo_mean = penguins[penguins['species'] == 'Gentoo']['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Confirm the highest mean
highest_mean_species = 'Gentoo' if gentoo_mean > chinstrap_mean and gentoo_mean > adelie_mean else ('Chinstrap' if chinstrap_mean > adelie_mean else 'Adelie')

# Output confirmation
adelie_mean, chinstrap_mean, gentoo_mean, highest_mean_species"}
